# MC-GPT (IOT-AI Suite)

> Natural-language multi-agent coding control plane for Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok and Ollama. Community Developer Preview 6.7.0-beta.6 / MC-GPT 0.8.0-alpha.6. Languages: English and German. production_claim: false.

The canonical public repository is https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT
Human landing page: https://iotaitech.github.io/MC-GPT/
Product site: https://iot-ai.tech
Release: https://github.com/IoTAiTech/MC-GPT/releases/tag/v6.7.0-beta.6
Contact: info@iot-ai.tech
Company: IoT-AI.Tech, Aschaffenburg, Bayern, Germany
Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/iot-ai-tech
Founder LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dr-babakskr
